summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US equivalent of a US 8-K) containing only an investor-relations notice that CEO David Stamler will present at the virtual Bell Potter Healthcare Conference on November 19, 2026, with an archived webcast to follow. No terms, no transaction, no board recommendation beyond standard authorization. It is a routine conference-presentation announcement for a clinical-stage biotech, not a special situation. The deal-risk angle is nil; watch only for clinical or financing updates (e.g., the planned Phase 3 MSA trial) that could drive ASX/NASDAQ shares.
